title: Ummat ne Hai Sataya Zahra Nu
body:
Ummat Ne Hai Sataya Zahra Nu
<<DIVIDER>>
Kar Kay Qatal Ali Nu, Syedan Nu Vi, Haye Pardes Rulaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis Dar Tay Ahkay Rukda Nabiyaan Na Maan Mola
Ahmad Nay Hay Banaya Jinon Apnay Badh Mola
Waliyan Day Us Wali Ton Kyon Vaer Lain Laye
Haye Us Ghaar Nu Jalaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Duniya Tay Jisdi Logo Kaba Hay Ja Wildat
Chahray Dey Jis Nu Takna Momin Di Hay Ibadat
Ous Nooray Kibraya Da Vich Sajday Kalma Go
Haye Kyon Khoon Bahaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis Shehar Vich Si Shahi Mola Ay Murtaza Di
Ous Shehar Vich Hay Kiti Aj Zalima Munadi
Aj Apni Hay Fatah Da Mola Day Qatal Da
Haye Kyon Jashan Manaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zahra Nay Jis Day Kurtay Apnay Hathan Nal Seetay
Us Bawafa De Bazo Tan Ton Juda Ne Keetay
Ay Janda Ay Ghazi Ya Janda Khuda
Haye Kinj Zeen To Layaa.
<<DIVIDER>>
Mumtaz Syedan Nu Kufa Na Ras Aaya
Sajjad Ban Kay Qaidi Kufay Ch Kinj Si Aya
Haider Diyan Dhiyan Nu Hathan Ch Rasyan Pa
Haye Kufay Ch Phiraya.
